title: config/documents.json
description: The documents that scripts/kit/check-documents.mjs checks: which Markdown files are documents, its status tables and changelogs. Its checklists are in config/checklist.json.

include.description: Globs of the tracked Markdown files that are documents; every English document has a Korean twin .ko.md.

exclude.description: Globs of tracked Markdown files that are not documents.

siteLinks.description: True when a static site renders the documents: a link that starts with / is not checked, and a link without extension may name a file with .md, .ko.md or index.md.

interpolation.description: Globs of the English documents (and their Korean twins) in which {{ outside a fenced code block fails, because the site renderer evaluates it.

path.description: The English document with the table; its Korean twin is read too.

idPattern.description: The source of the regular expression that the first cell of a row matches as a whole.

cells.description: The number of cells of a row.

enum.description: The values the cell may have; the English and the Korean row must agree on it.

pattern.description: The source of the regular expression that the cell matches.

changelogs.description: The English changelogs; their Korean twins are read too.
